## Summary

## Validation

What did you verify? State clearly anything you could not verify.

## Relevant checks

- [ ] Focused change with no unrelated cleanup.
- [ ] Tests are proportional to risk, or no executable behavior changed.
- [ ] Migrations and idempotency were considered when relevant.
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, personal data, or unsafe logs were added.
- [ ] Documentation, ADRs, or gaps were updated when their truth changed.
- [ ] Free-tier and non-technical-user impact were considered when relevant.
- [ ] Third-party code/assets have compatible terms and documented provenance, or none were added.
